Follow the [guard contract](../../../docs/guide/guarded-workflow.md) first. It overrides legacy shared-state writes and same-turn execution. Save auxiliary notes under .omg/drafts/.

Inspect controller status; require research. Save .omg/drafts/probe.json with argv
and optional required:true. Controller probe accepts only node/python/agy --version
or agy [up to three simple topics] --help. No shell strings or project code execution.
It records real exit status, full log and immutable JSON receipt, returning at most
8192 output bytes. A failed required probe prevents handoff; report EXTERNAL_ISSUE
or MISSING_CAPABILITY instead of guessing. SDK APIs still require reading the exact
versioned companion source/docs via /oma-read; CLI help is not proof of SDK behavior.
Do not add flags based on memory or convert a failed probe to a successful claim.
